correctness.rationale: The equivariant disjoint-support cubical model applies to the two-point graph configuration space. For GP(12,5), exhaustive enumeration constructs (276,792,558) integral cellular ranks and verifies ∂1∂2=0. Rank ∂2≥504 follows from exact modular elimination over F101; 54 explicitly closed octagon-pair torus chains give the opposite rank bound. Their selected 54x54 coordinate determinant is exactly −1, giving a primitive full-rank direct summand and an integral basis for ker ∂2=H2≅Z54. Complete integer coordinate reconstruction and Smith normal forms yield rank30 primitive (6,6), full-rank index4 with two factors2 (6,8), and full-rank saturated (8,8). Full 144 automorphism maps verify orbit partitions. All claims are graph-specific finite computations, with the symbolic integral-rank/saturation argument supplied in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a distinguished 24-vertex symmetric toroidal, nonplanar cubic graph (Eppstein, 2007). Disjoint short-cycle product tori are the canonical geometric H2 generators for two graph particles, and their integral generation is not determined by Betti numbers. Hexagon pairs support only a primitive 30-dimensional sublattice, mixed pairs span all 54 dimensions rationally but miss two 2-primary directions, whereas octagon pairs admit a unit-determinant integral basis. These are natural length-threshold and saturation invariants directly addressing geometric generator questions beyond the planar theorem of An–Knudsen.
